skill_name: Educate a customer on the importance of making an electricity payment.
workflow: It is important to make your electricity payments on time in order to maintain a good credit rating. Failure to make payments can have serious consequences, such as late fees, increased interest rates, diminished credit scores, and time-consuming disputes with utility companies. By making your payments on time, you are also helping to keep your energy costs in check, as late payments may result in higher energy bills.
